# Pull Request Template

## Description

Please describe the changes you've made and the motivation for this pull request.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide
- [ ] My change follows the house style (no em dashes, no emojis, no agent references)
- [ ] I have run `node scripts/check-repo.mjs` and all checks pass
- [ ] Commit authorship is with `maxxexee` only (no co-author or generated-by trailers)
- [ ] No private keys or secrets are committed
